hook: BlinkLinMulT uses linear attention for fast eye blink detection.

takeaways.text: It replaces quadratic attention with linear versions for easier training while maintaining performance.
The model achieves a perfect F1 score of 1.0 for blink presence detection on the TalkingFace dataset.
Training on a union of datasets improves robustness across all individual unseen benchmarks.

question: How do you handle performance drops at extreme head orientations in your models?
